name: Tilt Shift
description: Tilt shift miniature: a sharp band across the frame with growing blur above and below, plus a saturation boost.

params.name: focus
params.description: Height of the middle of the sharp band, 0 = top, 1 = bottom

params.name: width
params.description: Half height of the sharp band

params.name: falloff
params.description: Distance over which the blur grows to full

params.name: angle
params.description: Tilt of the band in degrees

params.name: saturation
params.description: Color saturation, for the toy look
